messages:
mira: Quick FYI — I opened an API PR that slightly reorders the feature flag header check. This breaks the SDK change in flight (sdk repo) until we bump the client. PRs: api#2205, sdk#4123. Need to coordinate merges so console doesn't see a mismatch.

alex: thanks for the heads-up. can you paste the exact header change? I want to validate the shim in sdk#4123.

mira: sure — old: `X-Feature-Flag: <json>` new: `X-Feature-Flags: <key>=true;v=1` (we normalized to semicolon-delimited for downstream routers).

sam: ok — sdk client currently parses the old shape. small change in `headers.ts` and a unit test. i can ship a patch today assuming api goes to canary after merge.

jen: console depends on sdk@^1.4.2. if sdk publishes a breaking minor we need to cut a console PR to update. prefer to hold console merge until both api + sdk are in prod.

rahul: quick question — does helm-runtime need any config change for the header rewrite? runtime proxies do header passthrough today. if it's just name + format we should be fine, but want to make sure no env var parsing.

mira: runtime: no change expected. proxy will pass header through unchanged; router parses on arrival.

sam: plan proposal: 1) mira merges api#2205 to staging canary at 16:00 PT today. 2) i merge sdk#4123 to main + publish a patch (1.4.3) 3) jen opens console PR to bump sdk dep to 1.4.3 and smoke. 4) if canary looks green for 1 hour, promote api to prod and then console merges.

alex: tagging @jen and @rahul as owners for console + runtime validation. also @mira — can we add a feature-flag gated compatibility shim in api for one day to avoid user impact if publish gets delayed?

mira: yes i can add a short-lived compatibility branch behind feature flag. i'll add `ff:compat.header_v1` and enable it only in staging until sdk is released.

jen: sounds good. i'll queue the console PR and set it as `hold` until sam confirms publish. pls ping me once the npm publish is done.

sam: publishing now -> `npm publish @redwood/sdk 1.4.3` 

dep-bot: npm release detected: @redwood/sdk v1.4.3 (sdk#4123) — see changelog: https://internal/repo/sdk/CHANGELOG.md#1.4.3

jen: got the pub, opened console PR console#657, set `depends-on: sdk#4123` in the PR description.

mira: canary is green after 30m. enabling `ff:compat.header_v1`=off in staging to validate real path.

rahul: validated runtime logs — header arrives as `X-Feature-Flags` and router parses fine. no errors in helm logs.

alex: ok let's schedule prod roll at 18:00 PT. jen pls merge console#657 after you run a quick smoke (login + feature flows). if anything breaks, revert console or toggle the ff.

jen: will smoke at 17:40 and merge after confirmation.

mira: thanks all — filing a short post in #eng-releases after prod rollout. :rocket:

sam: merging sdk#4123 now.

jen: smoke done, flows look good. merging console#657.

dep-bot: deploy started: api#2205 -> prod at 18:02 PT

mira: prod rollout complete at 18:10. monitoring for 20m.

alex: cheers, everyone. good coordinated work. i'll close the dependent chan in the crossrepo board.

jen: noted. leaving an approval + release note in console#657.

sam: tagging sdk#4123 closed.

mira: closing compat flag and removing temporary shim.

alex: final action items: jen add release note, rahul confirm helm chart unaffected in next patch, mira mark postmortem not needed. all good. :thumbsup:
